name: International student seeking local work around London classes

context.occupation: University student seeking part-time retail, hospitality or campus work
constraints: Wants identifiable employers and paid work
Employer requirements and permitted work/hours must be checked independently
context.company_awareness: Little employer preference; campus and nearby workplaces first

trigger: The class timetable becomes clear and the student needs a manageable source of earnings without accepting incompatible shifts.

searches_run.query: part time student jobs London evenings weekends
searches_run.observation: Results included job boards, campus resources and local roles with variable hours. Part-time search pages also included professional posts or varying shifts, so the label did not establish compatibility with lectures.

searches_run.query: London university student part time jobs employer careers fixed weekly hours
searches_run.observation: University careers services and campus staffing schemes appeared alongside roles requiring professional experience. Direct Roehampton inspection described paid flexible campus work and registration of availability, rather than a guaranteed vacancy or hours.

sources.title: Part-time student evening work jobs — Indeed
sources.supports: Retrieved page includes local school lettings roles advertised at average weekly hours, illustrating schedule details beyond a part-time label. Current individual openings were not inspected.

sources.title: URJobs temporary staff — University of Roehampton
sources.supports: Direct university page describes paid campus roles, availability preferences and a registration/matching process. It is not a confirmed vacancy for this student; campus eligibility and personal work conditions remain unverified.

sources.title: Part-time work — LSE Careers
sources.supports: Retrieved university guidance points students to its own vacancy platform and campus/external options. The persona's access to this institution's services is not assumed.

best_entry_page.primary_query: part time jobs London international students
best_entry_page.promise: Do not build a dedicated eligibility-led acquisition promise from current capabilities; local covered-employer search can only supplement the student's existing university routes.
best_entry_page.cta: If relevant nearby employers are covered, use free searches and inspect the actual shift requirements.
proof_needed: Verify local hourly-work and campus employer coverage.
Prove useful locality and schedule detail before prioritising this audience.
No personal eligibility or allowed-hours determination from job descriptions.
Do not present staffing registration as an immediately open job.
Do not imply timetable integration, shift booking or guaranteed hours.
Any future page must clearly distinguish supplemental search from institutional advice.

conversion_objections: Are there jobs near my campus or only graduate careers?
Can I see days and shift lengths?
Is this a specific opening or just a staffing pool?
Does your site know my personal restrictions?
Why use this before my university's job service?
Will alerts be useful before I know which employers to follow?

avoid_targeting.query: jobs guaranteed legal for student visa London
avoid_targeting.reason: Personal eligibility and permitted work cannot be promised.

avoid_targeting.query: international student allowed work hours calculator
avoid_targeting.reason: No legal or visa determination capability demonstrated.

avoid_targeting.query: cash jobs no checks London student
avoid_targeting.reason: Does not fit the legitimate identifiable-employer search.
Shift-booking marketplace capability is not demonstrated.

message_to_founder: Simulation: I need a nearby paid shift that fits between classes, not a list of graduate schemes. I might use free searches if you cover those employers, but I would still check my own work conditions and the actual rota separately.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic student scenario. Two queries and one university-page inspection. No institution, course, visa category, nationality, permitted hours or employer eligibility supplied or inferred. This is a low-priority acquisition hypothesis because campus routes and local schedule matching may serve the need better.
